claim.summary: Repeats resolve in lexical scope, materialize atomically in source order, reject overflow without truncation, and reconcile type-sensitive key-path identity deterministically.

semantics.itemsEvaluation: incoming parent scope before own alias
semantics.aliasExtent: child key and repeated subtree only
semantics.keyIdentity: RFC 8785 canonical JSON with JSON type retained
semantics.instanceIdentity: document, surface, source node, and complete outer-to-inner repeat-key path

focusedTestTitles: creates a branded root only from a real snapshot with an empty item namespace
resolves items before introducing the repeat's own alias
preserves source-array order instead of sorting by key
exposes each alias only in its own child scope without sibling or root leakage
lets a nested repeat see outer aliases and extends the key path outer-to-inner
rejects active alias shadowing while disjoint siblings may reuse the alias
accepts scalar items and resolves the alias root directly
treats prototype-sensitive alias names as ordinary isolated data
materializes an empty repeat without evaluating its key
distinguishes non-array items from unresolved and deferred item values
does not let a fallback hide a resolved null items value
rejects a %s repeat key without partial instances
rejects a missing key at its exact item without exposing earlier successes
uses a valid fallback for a missing item key
keeps numeric and string keys distinct while canonicalizing negative zero
defers token and format keys at the exact key location
structurally rejects a malformed key even when the item array is empty
accepts the exact explicit limit and rejects limit plus one without truncation
enforces the exact 1,000-instance profile ceiling
rejects malformed, accessor-backed, sparse, cyclic, and decorated input
detaches caller input and recursively freezes successful output
rejects forged scopes without throwing or exposing a partial result
turns aggregate child-scope budget overflow into a controlled result
creates a canonical identity from the base tuple and complete key path
preserves exact identity across reorder and ignores array index
requires replacement when an own repeat key changes
resets mount generation when a key changes after an earlier capability remount
requires replacement when an ancestor repeat key changes
requires a remount on the same key path when capability changes
requires replacement when the document, surface, or source node changes
rejects root scopes, forged scopes, identities, and malformed descriptors
compilerNegativeLabels: opaque repeat scopes cannot be constructed by shape
opaque repeated identities cannot be constructed by shape
repeat items are inert ValueSpecs, never callbacks
repeat keys come from the branded scope, not the base descriptor
rootMutationTestTitles: accepts tracked deterministic M04-T07 repeat evidence
rejects stale or tampered repeat evidence
detects key coercion and negative-zero drift
detects public export, TSDoc, and platform drift
detects focused-test and compiler-negative inventory drift

deferred: conditional repeated-subtree lifecycle and dependency reevaluation (M04-T15)
resource and operation lifecycles inside repeated scopes (M04-T08/M04-T09)
adapter instance preservation and declared prop remount policy (M05-T05)
